# [Implementation] - Task Plan

## 1. Context

- Smoke section extracted from the archived #315 plan at #364; the body is omitted.

### Manual Smoke Test Protocol

Every block is runnable as written from the worktree root. Blocks that mutate state build a
throwaway sandbox under `$HOME/.cache/agyloop/` (the tool's own recognised smoke sandbox) and
`env -u AGY_SUBAGENT` is used so the root-mutation guard does not block them.

#### Check 1 — `status` survives a closed pipe (AC-1, AC-2)

```bash
node bin/codeloop.js status 2>/tmp/co315-status.err | head -1
echo "PIPESTATUS[0]=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
wc -c < /tmp/co315-status.err
# expected:
#                                        (line 1 of the report is its leading blank line)
# PIPESTATUS[0]=0
# 0                                      (no stack trace on stderr)
```

```bash
node bin/codeloop.js status 2>/dev/null | head -2 | tail -1
# expected: === CodeLoop: Pipeline Status ===
```

```bash
node bin/codeloop.js status >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"
# expected: exit=0
```

#### Check 2 — `plan --dry-run` prints no advance (AC-5)

```bash
out=$(node bin/codeloop.js plan --issue 315 --dry-run 2>&1); rc=$?
case "$out" in
  *"Pipeline advanced"*) echo "FAIL: claimed an advance: $out" ;;
  *) echo "OK: no advance line (exit $rc)" ;;
esac
# expected: OK: no advance line (exit 0)
```

```bash
out=$(node bin/codeloop.js plan --issue 315 --dry-run 2>&1)
printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -E 'Subagent|Model Tier' && echo "printed" || echo "absent"
# expected depends on the stage the checkpoint is at when you run the gate:
#   checkpoint at PLAN            -> printed  (AC-4: PLAN *is* the next actionable stage, so the block is correct)
#   checkpoint anywhere else      -> absent   (AC-3: no planner/pro attribution before PLAN is next actionable)
# The failure mode this check must catch is "absent while at PLAN", or "printed at DISCOVERY / QUALITY_GATE / COMMIT".
# At QUALITY_GATE (where the gate runs) the expected line is: absent
```

#### Check 3 — `next --json` at COMMIT is not actionable and carries a pause (AC-7)

```bash
ROOT=$(pwd); CLI="$ROOT/bin/codeloop.js"; SB="$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-315-commit"
rm -rf "$SB" && mkdir -p "$SB/.agyloop/tasks" "$SB/artifacts/plans/315-smoke"
git -C "$SB" init -q -b main
git -C "$SB" config user.email smoke@test && git -C "$SB" config user.name smoke
printf 'x\n' > "$SB/README.md"
git -C "$SB" add -A && git -C "$SB" commit -qm "chore: seed"
git -C "$SB" checkout -qb task/315
NOW=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
node -e '
const fs = require("fs");
const [dir, now] = process.argv.slice(1);
fs.writeFileSync(dir + "/.agyloop/tasks/315.json", JSON.stringify({
  version: "1.0.0", currentStage: "COMMIT", mode: "standard", issue: 315,
  baseBranch: "main", planDir: "artifacts/plans/315-smoke",
  worktree: { taskId: 315, worktreePath: dir, branch: "task/315", baseBranch: "main", isIsolated: false },
  createdAt: now, updatedAt: now, totalHumanWaitMs: 0,
  history: [{ stage: "DISCOVERY", timestamp: now }, { stage: "COMMIT", timestamp: now }]
}));
' "$SB" "$NOW"
( cd "$SB" && env -u AGY_SUBAGENT node "$CLI" next --issue 315 --json ) > /tmp/co315-next.json 2>/tmp/co315-next.err
node -e '
const j = JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync("/tmp/co315-next.json", "utf8"));
console.log("actionType=" + j.actionType);
console.log("actionable=" + j.actionable);
console.log("pauseGate=" + (j.pause && j.pause.gate));
console.log("resumeCommand=" + (j.pause && j.pause.resumeCommand));
'
# expected:
# actionType=human_gate
# actionable=false
# pauseGate=COMMIT
# resumeCommand=null
```

#### Check 4 — the COMMIT directive names the delivery step (AC-21)

```bash
node -e '
const j = JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync("/tmp/co315-next.json", "utf8"));
const text = j.humanSummary + " " + j.description;
console.log("has_create_pr=" + text.includes("--create-pr"));
console.log("says_not_delivered=" + /not delivered/i.test(text));
console.log("names_agyloop=" + /\bagyloop\b/.test(text));
'
# expected:
# has_create_pr=true
# says_not_delivered=true
# names_agyloop=false
```

#### Check 5 — `sync` never writes `agyloop` to GitHub (AC-8, AC-33)

```bash
grep -c "Closed by agyloop sync" src/application/sync.ts || true
grep -c "Closed by codeloop sync" src/application/sync.ts
grep -rn "\[agyloop\]" src/ | wc -l
# expected:
# 0
# 1
# 0
```

```bash
node --test tests/application/sync-use-case.test.ts 2>&1 | tail -3
# expected: a passing summary line — no failing tests; the posted body asserts `Closed by codeloop sync:`
```

node bin/codeloop.js --version
node bin/codeloop.js --version | grep -c '^codeloop v'

#### Check 7 — an unresolvable release ref exits non-zero with a distinct message (AC-28, AC-29)

```bash
node bin/codeloop.js release phase/6-codeloop --base-branch nosuchbranch-315 --dry-run >/tmp/co315-rel.out 2>/tmp/co315-rel.err
echo "exit=$?"
grep -c "Cannot resolve base ref" /tmp/co315-rel.err || true
grep -c "Cannot resolve base ref" /tmp/co315-rel.out || true
grep -c "has no new commits" /tmp/co315-rel.err || true
grep -c "has no new commits" /tmp/co315-rel.out || true
# expected:
# exit=1
# 1      (stderr names the unresolvable ref)
# 0      (stdout carries no error prose)
# 0      (the "no new commits" sentence must NOT appear on stderr)
# 0      (nor on stdout)
```

#### Check 8 — a squash body renders N+1 changelog entries (AC-26, AC-27, AC-31)

```bash
node -e '
const { SemVerCalculator } = require("./dist/domain");
const body = "- fix(worktree): keep the repository root\n* fix(lifecycle): forward noWorktree\n  * fix(preflight): halt on evidence";
const r = SemVerCalculator.evaluate([{ header: "fix(worktree): [Phase 6] teardown (#247) (#253)", body }]);
const entries = r.changelog.split("\n").filter((l) => l.trim().startsWith("- "));
console.log("entries=" + entries.length);
console.log("total=" + r.totalCommits);
console.log("commitObjects=" + r.commitObjects);
console.log("has_lifecycle=" + r.changelog.includes("**lifecycle:**"));
'
# expected:
# entries=4
# total=4
# commitObjects=1
# has_lifecycle=true
```

#### Check 9 — `status --json` carries all four counters (AC-11)

```bash
node bin/codeloop.js status --json | node -e '
let s = ""; process.stdin.on("data", (d) => (s += d)).on("end", () => {
  const j = JSON.parse(s);
  for (const k of ["discoveryDispatchCount", "planDispatchCount", "reviewDispatchCount", "implementationDispatchCount"]) {
    console.log(k + "=" + (k in j));
  }
  console.log("stateFileExists=" + (typeof j.stateFileExists === "boolean"));
});'
# expected:
# discoveryDispatchCount=true
# planDispatchCount=true
# reviewDispatchCount=true
# implementationDispatchCount=true
# stateFileExists=true
```

#### Check 10 — `QUALITY_GATE → PLAN` names the re-plan, not the walk-back (AC-10)

```bash
ROOT=$(pwd); CLI="$ROOT/bin/codeloop.js"; SB="$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-315-qg"
rm -rf "$SB" && mkdir -p "$SB/.agyloop/tasks" "$SB/artifacts/plans/315-smoke"
git -C "$SB" init -q -b main
git -C "$SB" config user.email smoke@test && git -C "$SB" config user.name smoke
printf 'x\n' > "$SB/README.md" && git -C "$SB" add -A && git -C "$SB" commit -qm "chore: seed"
NOW=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
node -e '
const fs = require("fs"); const [dir, now] = process.argv.slice(1);
fs.writeFileSync(dir + "/.agyloop/tasks/315.json", JSON.stringify({
  version: "1.0.0", currentStage: "QUALITY_GATE", mode: "standard", issue: 315,
  baseBranch: "main", planDir: "artifacts/plans/315-smoke",
  createdAt: now, updatedAt: now, totalHumanWaitMs: 0,
  history: [{ stage: "QUALITY_GATE", timestamp: now }]
}));
' "$SB" "$NOW"
( cd "$SB" && env -u AGY_SUBAGENT node "$CLI" transition PLAN --issue 315 ) >/tmp/co315-qg.out 2>/tmp/co315-qg.err
echo "exit=$?"
grep -c "return to the gate" /tmp/co315-qg.err || true
grep -c "APPROVAL" /tmp/co315-qg.err
# expected:
# exit=0
# 0                                     (no gate walk-back)
# 1                                     (the re-plan sequence is named)
```
